NATIONAL WAGES CONSULTATIVE COUNCIL ACT 2011

MINIMUM WAGES (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 23(2) of the National Wages

Consultative Council Act 2011 [Act 732], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Minimum Wages (Amendment) Order 2013.

Amendment of paragraph 3

2. The Minimum Wages Order 2012 [P.U. (A) 214/2012], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 3—

(a) by renumbering the existing provision as subparagraph (1) of that

paragraph; and

(b) by inserting after subparagraph (1) the following subparagraphs:

"(2) This Order shall not apply to foreign employees

employed by the employers specified in column (1) of the Second

Schedule for the period specified in column (3) of the Second

Schedule.

(3) For the purpose of subparagraph (2), "foreign

employee" means an employee who is not a citizen of Malaysia.".

Amendment of Schedule

3. The Schedule to the principal Order is amended by substituting for the word

"SCHEDULE" the words "FIRST SCHEDULE".

New Second Schedule

4. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 3(2)]
